plugins.name: che-apple-mail-mcp
plugins.description: Shell v2.43.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.25.0) — imported the compose-wrapper-free rule from the server repo: formal-mail cite-block discipline (wrapper-free eligibility, [legacy path] disclosure duty, sender/recipient/attachment recipes, TCC fallback ladder). Binary v2.24.0 — #297 AppleScript execution is bounded by a timeout + a fail-fast Automation pre-flight, so a stuck call can no longer take the whole MCP server down. Every AppleScript tool funnels through MailController.runScript/runScriptAsList, which called the synchronous, un-timeout'd NSAppleScript.executeAndReturnError: when this binary's Automation grant is .notDetermined (prompt pending but unanswerable headless) or Mail is unresponsive it blocks INDEFINITELY rather than returning -1743, wedging the request thread until the MCP client's ~120s idle timeout dropped the ENTIRE connection (all 53 tools offline, not just the one call) — search_emails stayed fine throughout because it reads the Envelope Index via MailSQLite and issues no Apple event, the boundary that pinned the root cause. Distinct from #287 (zero-TCC open_mailto) and #288 (-1743 returned-error guidance): both address the denial-that-returns; this is the never-returns mode, which has no mailto equivalent on the read/archive side. Fix at the single shared choke point (all tools covered at once): runGuarded runs the execution on a detached thread and waits on a DispatchSemaphore with a 45s default deadline (well under the client's ~120s, far above normal 1-2s Mail IPC; scriptTimeout test seam), throwing the new MailError.scriptTimedOut instead of hanging — NSAppleScript is a blocking, uncancellable C API so a timed-out thread is deliberately abandoned, bounding the block rather than pretending cancellation; preflightAutomation reuses the non-prompting AutomationStatus.probe() (#293) to fail fast on .denied (reusing AutomationHelp.guidance verbatim) and .targetNotRunning, while .notDetermined/.granted proceed under the guard (never false-fast a legitimate first-run prompt). New MailControllerTimeoutTests: a 5s-sleeping runner returns .scriptTimedOut in 0.505s against a 0.5s deadline. 1029 tests pass. Binary v2.23.1 — #219/#295/#296 sender-popup live-fix trilogy (all surfaced by a live smoke against real Mail, uncatchable by unit tests): #295 the From-popup scan no longer leaks a raw -2700 on a settling AX tree (indexed guarded fetch); #296 the popup MENU is polled for population before enumeration (in-process NSAppleScript can see it empty right after click) + re-click-once; #219 (reopened) the clean custom-sender path finally works — Mail'\''s From popup renders 'Name – addr' (space EN DASH space, no angle brackets) so senderMatches now matches the last space-delimited token (anti-spoof: exact , addr gated no-whitespace), and the From control is identified by its stable AXIdentifier 'popup_from' (not a value-@ scan a signature popup could satisfy — Codex BLOCKING→PASS). Live end-to-end: create_draft with from_address returned '[sender verified via From popup: …]' with matching saved-draft sender. Binary v2.23.0 — 9-issue release: verified sender-popup so a simple custom from_address rides the clean wrapper-free path (#219, exact-suffix senderMatches + isSimpleAddrSpec gate + exactly-one From-popup, cross-model Codex R2→R5 + 2 Claude lenses); draft-only display-name To via GUI clipboard fill, To-only (#277); check_automation non-prompting Automation-TCC probe, the 3rd check_* axis (#293); -1743 actionable guidance (#288); open_mailto via LaunchServices zero-TCC (#287); atCount unicode-scalar (#289); parseRecipient quote-aware split (#286); batch_export fromPartialEmlx (#283); recipient lite-validator display-name/scalar angle scan (#280). Tool count 52→53; 1026 tests. Shell v2.38.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail `distributed_archives` config field (mail#285): generalizes Step 2.1 sibling-archive dedup to an opt-in list of arbitrary distribution-target archive dirs (not just symlinks under output_dir), so a capture-then-distribute workflow's capture-layer run folds already-distributed mail's message_id into the dedup set and never re-pulls it — no manual tombstone; read-only + bounded, a missing distributed dir warns (unlike the silent symlink scan), unset is a 100% backward-compatible no-op. Shell v2.33.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail Step 8.5 manifest-driven reconcile + atomic index write (plugins#110, stacked on plugins#107): the end-of-run Index Reconcile Gate gains a Phase 0 that mechanically fills the current run's batch writes from the in-memory export manifest — file from written_path, key from the manifest message_id, date + thread_key from the written md frontmatter, subject from the Step 4.5 preview (frontmatter carries no subject; the preview is the only clean source, falling back to the body Subject: line only if the preview slice was not retained) — so those entries are built with zero heuristic subject-from-body (a correction of the issue's premise: the #107 verify established the manifest carries message_id + written_path but NOT date/subject/thread_key, so reconcile is a three-source merge, not a pure manifest consume). Phase 1 keeps the full output_dir scan for historical orphans (a prior interrupted run's manifest is gone; non-batch or externally-placed md), which still reconstruct from disk frontmatter + the Subject-line heuristic. Both the Step 6 index update and the Step 8.5 gate now write ${INDEX_FILE} via temp+rename (os.replace), a durable fix for the single-file partial-write corruption mode that is complementary to the gate's cross-file orphan coverage (mail#261's deferred durable-fix note). Shell v2.32.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail Step 5 batch-export migration (plugins#107, che-apple-mail-mcp#232 SOP-side landing): Step 5 gains a server-side batch-export primary path (Step 5.0) that replaces per-email get_email(format='text') + client-side transcription with batch_export_emails_markdown for archive lists ≥5 (per-email loop stays as Step 5.1 fallback for <5, enriched template, or batch failure). The tool's frozen frontmatter shares the same 6 core field names/order as the SOP simple template (message_id/thread_key/in_reply_to/date/sender/direction), refuting the original proposal's point-4 premise that thread_key/direction are client-side value-adds; a 6-AI re-verify then caught that it is NOT byte-for-byte (the tool strips a superset of reply prefixes for thread_key, lowercases sender, preserves the date offset, and appends a body_type field), so the SOP's per-email fallback rules were aligned to the binary to keep the two write paths from fragmenting threads.json. Mixed corpora split into two batch calls by direction — but partitioned by each id's OWN mailbox (Batch B = ids whose mailbox matchesSpecial(Sent); Batch A = the rest), NOT by recipe provenance (3b/3c subject sweeps carry the user's own sent mail, which the naive split mislabeled received), with Batch B passing a literal "Sent" label (the tool's direction heuristic is a substring match that a localized Sent name would miss); opts.filenames is passed per-id computed by the SOP's own filename rule to preserve the 50-archive naming convention (the tool's default slug strips Re:/collapses dashes, which would drift) but is only a REQUESTED name — the tool seeds its collision guard from on-disk .md and uniquifies every branch, so the authoritative stem/path is always the manifest item's written_path; attachments stay on client-side Step 5.5 (richer keyword classify + inline cid + cross-reference, not the tool's extension-only routing) so batch runs without include_attachments; the per-call manifest (items carry id/status/attachments always, message_id/written_path only for non-error items, and NO date/subject/thread_key) is retained for the plugins#110 Step 8.5 reconcile work stacked on this PR — Step 8.5 itself is unchanged here. Shell v2.31.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail Step 8b audit-denominator hardening (plugins#112, follow-up to plugins#109): the thread-completeness audit now fetches its total-count denominator via search_emails projection:summary + dedup:logical (collapsing a message's multi-mailbox Gmail copies server-side, grouped by subject+sender+date_received as a conservative Message-ID approximation — not exact per-Message-ID like the numerator) and then applies the same Step 3 mailbox drop-set (Drafts/Trash/exclude_mailboxes), so a Gmail thread carrying a draft or dual-stored INBOX/All-Mail rows stops over-counting into a phantom 'missing siblings' warning; when the match set exceeds the query limit the audit emits a truncation caveat and skips the comparison rather than falsely reporting complete. Shell v2.30.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail Step 3 search mechanization (plugins#109, follow-up to che-apple-mail-mcp#261): sent-mail detection becomes a scoped search_emails call (mailbox: <per-account Sent real name> + field: recipient) with a documented Tier-2 unscoped+post-filter fallback for mailbox-URL encoding mismatches; received/subject searches gain a mandatory Drafts/Trash post-filter on the result mailbox field (real names via get_special_mailboxes + exclude_mailboxes config) — the All-Mail superset discipline is now mechanically actionable instead of prose. Shell v2.29.0 (shell-only, binary stays v2.19.0) — archive-mail SOP hardening (che-apple-mail-mcp#261): mandatory end-of-run Index Reconcile Gate (orphan md → repaired index entries, last_updated = max(date), unparseable surfaced, run cannot succeed silently) + All-Mail superset trap discipline (sent-mail detection via the Sent mailbox, drafts excluded from the corpus, Message-ID dedup). Shell v2.28.0 ships binary v2.19.0 — 10-issue release: reply/forward send-stage POSTDISPATCH protection + MailController test seams closing the disclosure family-swap blind spot (#254); opt-in require_wrapper_free on compose_email/create_draft — clean failure with named reason + alternatives instead of a silently wrapped draft, strict POSTDISPATCH mapped to do-not-retry guidance (#239); non-ASCII attachment paths route to the legacy native-attach path instead of hanging the GUI go-to-folder sheet (#220); attachment savable:false false-negatives fixed via a name-free part-id-directory probe rescuing Mail's degraded on-disk filenames, hardened against .DS_Store and symlinks (#183); not-downloaded attachments now say so — savable_reason field + an actionable open-the-message error replacing the generic not-found/-10000 (#238); per-account inbox resolution in get_special_mailboxes, deferral lifted by a 7/7-account live check incl. a localized Exchange 收件匣 (#249); doc-count census with guard tests pinning every README/manifest claim to defineTools() (#248); export frontmatter dates preserve the original Date-header UTC offset with RFC 2822 trailing-comment tolerance (#244); the compose disclosure wiring gains a runnable regression lock via a pure router (#241); mailto send-stage failures refuse the legacy re-send — duplicate-outbound protection with a _dispatched success-path flag (#242). 6-AI verify per PR; suite 882, 0 failures. Shell v2.27.0 ships binary v2.18.0 — 14-issue release: `batch_export_emails_markdown` becomes the bulk-export tool's canonical name with `export_emails_markdown` as a zero-break deprecated alias (stderr warn, not removed before v3.0; #233 — fixes the #232 name-level discoverability incident); compose/create_draft (#237) and reply/forward (#229) no longer degrade silently to the wrapped-body legacy path (3 disclosure layers: result-string suffix + stderr warn + schema eligibility text); concurrent same-dir exports serialized via advisory flock fail-fast (#236); wrapper-free reply/forward clean path via native verb + cursor paste (#218); AppleScript search fallback honors field/date filters (#194); export output-path home-relative denylist + opt-in strict allowlist (#197) and symlink-swap TOCTOU race-free writes (#200); get_account_info/list_mailboxes account_id escape hatch + no more silent all-mailbox fallback (#202); deterministic search tie-ordering (#209); in_reply_to (#198) + body_type (#199) frontmatter; dedup-aware archive primitives — skip_message_ids_path + summary projection + batch message_id (#177); whose-content-contains O(corpus) scan guard (#221). 6-AI verify per PR; suite 815, 0 failures. Shell v2.26.0 ships binary v2.16.0 — Developer ID signing + notarization 讓 Full Disk Access grant 跨 version bump 不失效 (#211);FDA-denied 訊息改指 responsible process（終端機 / Claude Desktop）而非 binary 自己 (#214，libquarantine SPI 經驗證對 terminal/CLI-launched process 回 self、無法 in-process 解析確切 app，故只列候選不臆測);新增 Full Disk Access onboarding：`CheAppleMailMCP --setup` SwiftUI 設定視窗（live FDA 狀態 + on-demand Automation 檢查 + open-settings/copy-path 按鈕，授權後即時翻 Ready）、`--check-fda` headless、`check_fda` MCP tool，全 gated 在 flag 後不動 stdio path (#213);6-AI ensemble verify 兩輪、29 findings 全處理;test suite 677、0 failures。Shell v2.25.0 ships binary v2.15.0 — #208 `search_emails` gains `projection` (full/ids/count) + `dedup` (none/logical): `projection=ids` returns rowId-strings-only (no per-row recipient fetch, ~10–30× smaller payload, #204 truncation preserved); `projection=count` returns the total match count; `dedup=logical` collapses Gmail mailbox-duplicate rows server-side via GROUP BY (subject,sender,date_received). Omitting both is byte-identical to the existing full envelope. Spec-driven (search-id-projection). 659 tests/0 fail; follow-up #209. Shell v2.24.0 ships binary v2.14.0 — `search_emails` / `list_emails` truncation envelope (#204): these tools applied a SQL `LIMIT` and returned a bare array with no truncation signal, so bulk consumers (notably `export_emails_markdown` #193 archive) silently missed emails when a sender exceeded `limit`. Now both return an envelope `{results, returned, limit, truncated}` — the SQLite fast path fetches `limit+1` for a definitive `truncated`; the AppleScript fallback uses a documented best-effort `== limit` heuristic. A 6-AI idd-verify ensemble caught + fixed a CRITICAL negative-limit crash (`Array(prefix(-1))` trap) before merge via a `limit` clamp; suite 640, 0 failures. Breaking response-shape change (bare array → `.results`); consumer/doc update tracked in #205. Shell v2.23.0 ships binary v2.13.0 — new `export_emails_markdown` server-side bulk email→markdown export (#193): one call fetches a batch, renders verbatim markdown (frozen 6-field frontmatter) + optional attachments, returns a per-email manifest with partial-failure semantics — designed to take verbatim transcription off the LLM path for large archive jobs; a 6-AI idd-verify ensemble (5 Claude reviewers + cross-model Codex) caught two CRITICAL pre-merge arbitrary-write paths (sender-controlled attachment-name + per-id override traversal), fixed via shared leaf-path containment before merge. Also `get_special_mailboxes` per-account real-name resolution (#179) and `check_for_new_mail`/`synchronize_account` `account_id` escape hatch (#191); 6-AI ensemble verified; suite 624, 0 failures. plugins.name: math-tools
plugins.description: v0.5.0: Toolkit for academic math article editing — covers 5 scopes: (1) propositions extraction + R1-R13 mechanical validation (validate-propositions.py with normalize_for_match resilient substring containment: R1 prop-subset / R2 cite-resolve / R3 DAG / R7 UUID v7 / R8 unique-ids / R9 env-consistency / R10-R12 enum checks / R13 location-anchoring) + refresh-prop-locations.py for location-drift repair; (2) proofread workflow — JSONL-driven L1-L5 + location-drift 6-layer per-prop checklist (.proofread/<file>.md atomic granularity, 286-prop full-manuscript walk demonstrated); (3) manuscript audit R1-R4 with PR-side CI gate (audit-symbols / audit-citations / audit-code-manuscript per manuscript-consistency-audit.md SOP); (4) cross-doc sync rules — manuscript-jsonl-sync (prop-level main.tex <-> jsonl), manuscript-consistency-audit (audit-time SOP), code-and-manuscript-sync (repo-level cluster PR scope); (5) clarity-audit — free-form readability audit that finds where a human reader stalls (unanchored term / missing bridge, definition-away-from-use, claim-without-reason, notation collision, non-standard terminology) and rewrites the passage self-contained; the readability axis, complementary to proofread's per-proposition correctness axis (a passage can pass proofread and still be unreadable). Dogfood origin: PsychQuantHsu/psychophysical_representations #107 proofread workflow experiment (3 pilots, 5 findings shipped); clarity-audit distilled from the NSTC postdoc brief_proposal §3 clarity-refinement pass. v0.1.0 shipped skeleton SKILL.md bodies + 3 frozen baseline rules; v0.2.0 added clarity-audit with a complete execution body; v0.3.0 fleshes out the propositions / proofread / manuscript-audit skeletons into full self-contained execution bodies and bundles their scripts (validate-propositions.py, refresh-prop-locations.py, audit-{symbols,citations,code-manuscript}.py, run-audit.sh + _lib/latex_env_parser.py) and docs (SCHEMA.md, EXTRACTION-PROMPT.md) into the plugin — no more source-repo dependency; v0.4.0 sharpens the clarity-audit trigger description (explicit single-sentence scope + anti-under-trigger nudge) after a fresh-agent test showed it under-triggering on one-sentence asks. Use /devtools:plugin-update math-tools after each skill body refinement. v0.4.1 trims the four skill descriptions (front-loaded triggers, well under the 1536-char listing cap) so they survive the skill-listing budget instead of being dropped to name-only. v0.5.0 expands clarity-audit's reader-stumble taxonomy from six categories to nine, from a long manuscript-revision campaign: (7) unexpanded abbreviation or unexplained operator (PF, GMM, vech — mechanical to check, and load-bearing when q=p(p+1)/2 is the count of what vech returns); (8) prose that misdescribes the implementation (text saying 'initial communalities at 0.50' where the code sets uniquenesses to 0.50 of observed variance — the one class not diagnosable from prose, so read the code); (9) attribution the cited work itself contradicts (verify against what the cited paper says about its own contribution; its bibliography is the authoritative metadata source). Category 4 gains stale accents (tilde promoted to hat when a reframing makes the preliminary a full family member). The verify step now warns that a clean compile is not proof: preamble changes can delete content silently (fontspec dropping bold Greek capitals with only 'Missing character' in the log), so diff the rendered PDF text and compare glyph counts.
